sentences.text: This Court, at this juncture, is not going into the facts of the case.
The present proceedings arise primarily out of matrimonial disputes.
The FIR was lodged in 2008 in Meerut and criminal proceedings were going on in Uttar Pradesh.
Material on record indicates that proceedings under the Domestic Violence Act and the complaint filed by the Complainant before the Crime Against Women Cell were initiated in Delhi.
Be that as it may, the material on record shows that there was hardly any progress when the trial was going on in Uttar Pradesh.
By an Order dated 10.01.2023 passed by the Apex Court all the proceedings have been transferred to Delhi and the matter is pending in Delhi.

3. Looking at the fact that the FIR is of 2008 and substantial time has passed and also the fact that this case pertains to matrimonial dispute and speedy justice is the concomitant of Article 21 of the Constitution of India, in the facts of the present case, this Court directs the Trial Court to expedite the trial and conclude the same within one year from today.
4. Liberty is granted to the Petitioner to approach this Court once again if the trial is not concluded within one year.
5. With these directions, the Petition is disposed of, along with the pending applications, if any.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J JULY 12, 2024 Rahul
